_doc: Channel classification master for MT reporting. Business rule: Zone Sales contain MT accounts only; eB2B and SIS are reported as separate channels and are never added, allocated, mapped or rolled up into any MT zone figure. Sourced from dims.Channel in the article-wise primary; every listed account is 100% single-channel (verified: no chain carries both MT and non-MT primary).

EB2B.label: eB2B
EB2B.note: Reported as its own channel. Replaces the former 'Pan India' zone, which was this channel's largest account carried as a seventh geography.

SIS.label: SIS
SIS.note: Shop-in-Shop. Reported as its own channel. Primary is net of MRN returns.

decisions.decision: Exclude the whole Nykaa (FSN) account from Modern Trade and report it under eB2B.
decisions.accepted_consequence: The account combines FSN (B2C marketplace) with Nykaa SS (eB2B) at article level and the feed cannot separate them, so B2C e-commerce is reported inside eB2B until split feeds are supplied.

decisions.decision: Rename the 'Pan India' zone to 'eB2B' and report it as a channel, not a geography.
Report SIS as its own channel on the same basis as eB2B.
